config:
$ docker compose config
name: hello-devops
services:
  redis:
    restart: unless-stopped
    image: redis:8-alpine
    networks:
      default: null
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: redis-data
        target: /data
        volume: {}
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - redis-cli
        - ping
      timeout: 3s
      interval: 5s
      retries: 5
  web:
    develop:
      watch:
        - path: /Users/you/code/hello-devops/app.py
          action: sync+restart
          target: /app/app.py
        - path: /Users/you/code/hello-devops/requirements.txt
          action: rebuild
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      APP_VERSION: 1.0.0
      GREETING: Hello from Compose
      REDIS_HOST: redis
    networks:
      default: null
    build:
      context: /Users/you/code/hello-devops
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 8000
        published: "8000"
        protocol: tcp
networks:
  default:
    name: hello-devops_default
volumes:
  redis-data:
    name: hello-devops_redis-data
